scenarios.title: Riot gives an additional +1/+1 counter when that choice is made
decisions: A casts Zhur-Taa Goblin, tapping the Mountain and the Forest.
Both players pass; Zhur-Taa Goblin resolves and A chooses the +1/+1 counter for riot.

variants.label: counter_choice
variants.expected: Zhur-Taa Goblin enters with a +1/+1 counter on it: it is a 3/3 with one +1/+1 counter and does not have haste.

variants.label: haste_choice
variants.delta: A chooses haste for riot instead of the counter.
variants.expected: Zhur-Taa Goblin enters with no counter: it is a 2/2 with haste.

variants.label: no_riot
variants.delta: A casts Grizzly Bears instead of Zhur-Taa Goblin.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has no riot: it enters as a 2/2 with no counter and no haste.

scenarios.title: Riot gives haste when the counter is not chosen
decisions: A casts Zhur-Taa Goblin, tapping the Mountain and the Forest.
Both players pass; Zhur-Taa Goblin resolves and A chooses haste for riot.
A moves to the declare attackers step.

variants.label: haste_choice
variants.expected: Zhur-Taa Goblin has haste and is a legal attacker this turn.

variants.label: counter_choice
variants.delta: A chooses the +1/+1 counter for riot instead of haste.
variants.expected: Zhur-Taa Goblin has no haste and is summoning sick: it is not a legal attacker this turn.

scenarios.title: Each instance of riot works separately
decisions: A casts Zhur-Taa Goblin, tapping the Mountain and the Forest.
Both players pass; Zhur-Taa Goblin resolves. It has riot printed and riot from Rhythm of the Wild; A chooses the +1/+1 counter for both instances.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: Zhur-Taa Goblin enters with two +1/+1 counters: it is a 4/4 and does not have haste.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Rhythm of the Wild is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Only the printed riot applies: Zhur-Taa Goblin enters with one +1/+1 counter as a 3/3, without haste.

variants.label: counter_and_haste
variants.delta: A chooses the counter for one instance and haste for the other.
variants.expected: Zhur-Taa Goblin enters with one +1/+1 counter and has haste: it is a 3/3 with haste.

variants.label: two_haste
variants.delta: A chooses haste for both instances.
variants.expected: Zhur-Taa Goblin enters with no counter and has haste: it is a 2/2 with haste.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge asks for the riot choice once per instance; the two-instance case relies on Forge treating the granted and printed instances separately.
